scientific_choices.choice: Section3.5 and Algorithm2 compare image-only BLIP2 context with OCR and route uncertain images to DeepSolo. New caption-verification features are external experimental extensions.

Reuse image-hash-identified425 BLIP2 captions, original640 YOLO/PARSeq outputs, frozen scale/crop/coverage probes, pinned MPNet/CLIP, complete ViTAE+TextOCR DeepSolo outputs, original word metric and TRAIN80/45 partition.

No training, learned classifier, gradient update, correction, filtering or fitted mixture weights. All models frozen; only label-free TRAIN80 CDF scaling and empirical scalar-threshold calibration onTRAIN45. Threshold/family selection before newTEST features. TEST historically explored; all families reported, no claim of untouched validation.

Caption literal quoted/attributed tokens are imperfect non-exhaustive evidence. Exact multiset caption-token recovery can flag contradiction; absent caption evidence is not negative evidence. No GT lexicon. Near-spelling controls fixed substitution/reversal/deletion from existing deterministic helper.

CLIP crop margins compare original vs strongest spelling mutation with plain prompt, same image-only caption, and unrelatedTRAIN80 caption. Lower20th percentile per image. Context gain is own-caption margin minus unrelated-caption margin. MPNet contrasts full transcript against same caption minus mean3 unrelatedTRAIN80 captions. These score units are ranks, not probabilities of F1.

Frozen FLAN-T5-base teacher-forced Yes/No support/coherence probes are text-only plausibility controls. Record same-transcript wrong-caption control; cannot establish literal pixel evidence, complete localization or OCR F1.

Good-image label is local per-image exact-casefold multiset wordF1>=.8, no spatialIoU. Evaluate fraction of good accepted images, accepted-word metrics and combined microF1/TN0 separately. Calibrate80/90/95% empirical purity with at least5 accepted examples; no qualifying cut means allDeepSolo. Rank budgets are GT-free batch policies with explicit unfilled-budget counts.

Actual PAPER GPU qualified at run, separate sequential FP32 CLIP/MPNet/FLAN inference; no mixed precision, installs or downloads. Record input shapes/lengths, batch size, state hashes before/after, memory allocated/reserved and propagated OOM/failures. Outputs are external artifacts, not strict configuration.

Caption hallucinations, consistently wrong probes and missing-text errors limit achievable reliability. Only45 calibration images; no formal generalization guarantee. Per-image F1 classification and microF1 versus DeepSolo optimize different objectives. Table5 metric and strict artifacts remain unresolved.
